name: Fire Shield
description: Accursed covers an ally in a shield of flames, dispelling debuffs and stuns, absorbing incoming damage. If the shield breaks, it explodes dealing Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

source.notes: From hon_reborn_slice.json. Dispels StatusDebuff and StatusDisable on cast. Applies State_Accursed_Ability2 for 15s. Shield absorbs 110/140/170/200 post-mitigation damage. On break: Affector_Accursed_Ability2 spawned, AoE 700 radius for 110/140/170/200 Magic damage. Cooldown 18/15/12/9s per level. Mana 100/105/110/115.

adapted.adaptation_reason: Cooldown: ceil(18s / 5s) = 4 turns (level-1 worst case; level-4 = ceil(9/5)=2 turns). Duration: ceil(15s / 5s) = 3 turns. Shield absorb = 110 HP at level 1. Dispel on cast: removes Stun and all Debuffs from target — very powerful, key strategic ability. Explosion on break: adapted as AoE magic hit on all enemies (row model: all enemies in opposite front row). This is a critical defensive ability — Accursed's defining card.
